query: Считывай сообщения из Kafka topic orders.created, парси JSON, извлекай поля order_id, user_id, amount, created_at и вставляй строки в таблицу public.orders в PostgreSQL.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: kafka_pg_orders_etl
  name: Kafka to PostgreSQL Orders ETL
  description: Reads messages from Kafka topic orders.created, parses JSON, extracts
    key fields, and inserts them into PostgreSQL table public.orders
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: every 1 minute
sources:
- id: source_kafka
  name: Read Kafka Topic
  type: Kafka
  location: orders.created
  connection:
    properties:
      brokers: '{{KAFKA_BROKERS}}'
      group_id: '{{KAFKA_GROUP_ID}}'
processing_elements:
- id: process_extract_fields
  name: Parse JSON and Extract Fields
  operation: Extract
  config:
    fields:
    - order_id
    - user_id
    - amount
    - created_at
    input_format: json
sinks:
- id: sink_postgres
  name: Insert into PostgreSQL
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.orders
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
processed_data:
- id: parsed_orders
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_kafka
  to_id: process_extract_fields
  data_ref: parsed_orders
- from_id: process_extract_fields
  to_id: sink_postgres
  data_ref: parsed_orders
